newsitem.title: CHINA: Airbus to sell 30 jets to China in $1.5 bln deal.
newsitem.headline: Airbus to sell 30 jets to China in $1.5 bln deal.

text.p: Airbus Industrie signed a $1.5 billion deal with China on Thursday to supply 10 A320 and 20 A321 jets to Chinese airlines, company officials said.
"This marks the penetration into China of the A321," Airbus president and managing director Jean Pierson told reporters after the signing ceremony in the Great Hall of the People.
"It's a very important success and there will be other ones," he said, referring to future prospects for Airbus in China's rapidly growing aviation industry.
The deal to sell the 30 Airbus airliners would mean the creation of 3,600 jobs in France and a total of 12,000 jobs across Europe, Pierson said.
Airbus reached a previous deal to sell 30 A320 jets to China during a visit by Premier Li Peng to France last year.

Airbus airliners currently account for only about 15 percent of China's market, but Chinese officials have said they plan to expand the Airbus share to bring it closer to the level of Boeing, which currently dominates China's airways.
